questions.question: What are the budget category of the events located at MU 215 and a guest speaker type with a 0 budget spent?
questions.evidence: budget category refers to category; events located at refers to location; fld004 = 'Guest Speaker'; 0 budget spent refers to fld021 = 0;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T2.fld020, T1.fld004 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld017 WHERE T1.fld006 = 'MU 215' AND T2.fld021 = 0 AND T1.fld004 = 'Guest Speaker'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T2.category, T1.type FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.location = 'MU 215' AND T2.spent = 0 AND T1.type = 'Guest Speaker'

questions.question: Name the event with the highest amount spent on advertisement.
questions.evidence: Name of event refers to fld002; highest amount spent on advertisement refers to MAX(fld021) where fld020 = 'Advertisement'
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.fld002 FROM tab05 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T2 ON T1.fld017 = T2.fld001 WHERE T1.fld020 = 'Advertisement' ORDER BY T1.fld021 DESC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.event_name FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id WHERE T1.category = 'Advertisement' ORDER BY T1.spent DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Among the events attended by more than 10 members of the Student_Club, how many of them are meetings?
questions.evidence: meetings events refers to fld004 = 'Meeting'; attended by more than 10 members refers to COUNT(fld001) > 10
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.fld001) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld017 WHERE T1.fld004 = 'Meeting' GROUP BY T1.fld001 HAVING COUNT(T2.fld017) > 10
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.event_id) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.type = 'Meeting' GROUP BY T1.event_id HAVING COUNT(T2.link_to_event) > 10

questions.question: Tell the phone number of "Carlo Jacobs".
questions.evidence: Carlo Jacobs is the full name; full name refers to fld035, fld036;
questions.SQL: SELECT fld040 FROM tab08 WHERE fld035 = 'Carlo' AND fld036 = 'Jacobs'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT phone FROM member WHERE first_name = 'Carlo' AND last_name = 'Jacobs'

questions.question: Indicate the cost of posters for 'September Speaker' event.
questions.evidence: 'Posters' is the expense description; 'September Speaker' is an event name
questions.SQL: SELECT T3.fld028 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld017 INNER JOIN tab06 AS T3 ON T2.fld019 = T3.fld030 WHERE T1.fld002 = 'September Speaker' AND T3.fld026 = 'Posters'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T3.cost FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget WHERE T1.event_name = 'September Speaker' AND T3.expense_description = 'Posters'

questions.question: What is the amount of the funds that the Vice President received?
questions.evidence: 'Vice President' is a position of Student Club; funds received refers to amount.
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.fld023 FROM tab08 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab07 AS T2 ON T1.fld034 = T2.fld018 WHERE T1.fld038 = 'Vice President'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.amount FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.position = 'Vice President'

questions.question: List the name of students that have attended more than 7 events.
questions.evidence: name of students means the full name; full name refers to fld035, fld036; attended more than 7 events refers to COUNT(fld017) > 7
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld035, T1.fld036 FROM tab08 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T2 ON T1.fld034 = T2.fld018 GROUP BY T2.fld018 HAVING COUNT(T2.fld017) > 7
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member GROUP BY T2.link_to_member HAVING COUNT(T2.link_to_event) > 7
